description: Type operator producing the union of an object type's property names.
`T['key']` or `T[K]` looks up the type of a property; `T[number]` reads the element type of an array.
Constrains a type parameter to valid keys of `T`, so the key is checked and `T[K]` is exact.
Objects may have more properties than their type declares, so TypeScript does not promise `(keyof T)[]`.
